requirements.text: The actuator command shall always lie within the configured output range.
The demo harness drives the controller from a fixed sensor reading and reports the command.
The integral term shall not wind up: it shall stay within a fixed limit.
Every command is clamped to [outLo, outHi] on its way out of the PID step.
The integral accumulator is clamped to +/-1000000 after every tick.
Sensor and setpoint shall be within +/-32767 (gains within +/-16.0 in Q16.16), so no intermediate value overflows i32.
